'''Williston Basin Gas Pipeline,''' or the '''Williston Basin Interstate Pipeline''' is an operating natural gas pipeline.<ref name=source1>[http://bit.ly/2lnYibB Williston Basin Gas Pipeline,] Wikipedia, accessed September 2017</ref>

==Location==
The pipeline runs from Wyoming to Montana, South Dakota, and North Dakota.

==Background==
The Williston Basin Gas Pipeline is operated by Williston Basin Interstate Pipeline Company, a subsidiary of MDU Resources Group.<ref>[http://www.mdu.com/news/2012/05/21/mdu-resources-subsidiary-purchases-interest-in-bakken-oil-and-natural-gas-midstream-assets MDU Resources subsidiary purchases interest in Bakken oil and natural gas midstream assets], MDU Resources, May 21, 2012</ref>
